unstuck_said.text: Filed issue "Add a Nano (XNO) asset rail: permissionless and gas-less, no funding route before an agent can pay" on hifriendbot/agentwallet-mcp. Argued every rail the wallet drives has preconditions not about the agent (gas funding or facilitator, USDC+feePayer on Solana) — citing their own issue #14 about an "unfunded account" after pay_x402 — whereas Nano settles on the first interaction with no gas account to fund first. Offered the live Vend endpoint (extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/status, 0.0001 XNO, x402Version 2) and @x402nano/exact as a concrete nano:mainnet accept to test. Disclosed co
